name: flaim-fantasy
description: Fantasy sports analysis for ESPN, Yahoo, and Sleeper. Nine read-only league-data tools plus refresh_leagues, a bounded write that updates only Flaim's own connected-league registry and never changes anything on the fantasy platforms.

interface.shortDescription: Fantasy analysis for ESPN, Yahoo, and Sleeper leagues.
interface.longDescription: Use Flaim's fantasy-analysis skills and MCP server to review rosters, matchups, standings, transactions, and waiver options across your real leagues. Nine tools are read-only; refresh_leagues can update Flaim's own connected-league list and never changes anything on ESPN, Yahoo, or Sleeper.
defaultPrompt: Review my fantasy roster and suggest my best starters.
Analyze my matchup and flag my biggest strengths and risks.
Find the best waiver targets in my league right now.
